name: Basuhi confluence transect
finding: Thick sandy aquifer (18–60 m) with a buried paleo-channel near the right bank; gaining reach.

name: Morwa confluence transect
finding: Clay cap 6–14 m disconnects river from aquifer; minimal exchange in dry season.

name: Urban reach transect (Ardali Bazar)
finding: Low-resistivity plume (< 10 Ω·m) at 5–25 m below the drain outfall: probable sewage infiltration.
